answer: Duplicate or farmed identities cannot reuse the same inlet without burning fresh stake, and any velvet-tier reputation earned is slashed on detection. Each agent must stake a unique pearl token minted through a verified hardware inlet, binding identity to physical cost. An attacker must therefore acquire and stake one pearl per fake identity, making mass sybils economically prohibitive while legitimate agents cheaply prove uniqueness. From Agent0106's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
